mapper.select: SELECT opr.id, opr.order_id, o.order_no, opr.channel, opr.trade_no, opr.request_amount, opr.status, CASE WHEN opr.status = 'INIT' THEN '初始化' WHEN opr.status = 'PAYING' THEN '支付中' WHEN opr.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN '支付成功' WHEN opr.status = 'FAILED' THEN '支付失败' WHEN opr.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN '已取消' ELSE '未知状态' END as status_description, opr.response_payload, opr.created_time, opr.updated_time FROM order_pay_records opr LEFT JOIN orders o ON opr.order_id = o.id WHERE opr.order_id = #{orderId} AND opr.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY opr.created_time DESC

SELECT opr.id, opr.order_id, o.order_no, opr.channel, opr.trade_no, opr.request_amount, opr.status, CASE WHEN opr.status = 'INIT' THEN '初始化' WHEN opr.status = 'PAYING' THEN '支付中' WHEN opr.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN '支付成功' WHEN opr.status = 'FAILED' THEN '支付失败' WHEN opr.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN '已取消' ELSE '未知状态' END as status_description, opr.response_payload, opr.created_time, opr.updated_time FROM order_pay_records opr LEFT JOIN orders o ON opr.order_id = o.id WHERE opr.trade_no = #{thirdPayNo} AND opr.is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE order_pay_records SET status = #{status}, response_payload = #{callbackData, typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler}, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT o.merchant_id AS merchantId, opr.channel AS channel, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, SUM(opr.request_amount) AS channelAmount, SUM(opr.request_amount) AS totalRevenue FROM order_pay_records opr INNER JOIN orders o ON opr.order_id = o.id WHERE DATE(opr.created_time) = #{statDate} AND opr.status = 'SUCCESS' AND opr.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY o.merchant_id, opr.channel

SELECT opr.channel AS channel, o.merchant_id AS merchantId, o.store_id AS storeId, COUNT(*) AS transactionCount, SUM(opr.request_amount) AS transactionAmount, 0 AS refundCount, 0 AS refundAmount FROM order_pay_records opr INNER JOIN orders o ON opr.order_id = o.id WHERE DATE(opr.created_time) = #{statDate} AND opr.status = 'SUCCESS' AND opr.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY opr.channel, o.merchant_id, o.store_id

SELECT o.merchant_id AS merchantId, o.store_id AS storeId, SUM(o.final_paid_price) AS totalReceivable, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(#{statDate}, o.payment_time) <= 7 THEN o.final_paid_price ELSE 0 END) AS aging0To7, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(#{statDate}, o.payment_time) BETWEEN 8 AND 15 THEN o.final_paid_price ELSE 0 END) AS aging8To15, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(#{statDate}, o.payment_time) BETWEEN 16 AND 30 THEN o.final_paid_price ELSE 0 END) AS aging16To30, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(#{statDate}, o.payment_time) > 30 THEN o.final_paid_price ELSE 0 END) AS aging30Plus FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('PAID', 'PENDING_VERIFICATION', 'COMPLETED') AND o.profit_sharing_status IN (1, 2) AND o.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY o.merchant_id, o.store_id
